senses.gloss: m. (Ithpe. or Ispe. of סְוַר = שָׁוַר to leap, stride; b. h. אֲשׁוּר; cmp. אִסְפֶּירֶס) ankle, foot-step.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 23:11">Targ. Job XXIII, 11</cite>; a. e.
Yeb. 103ᵃ; Arakh. 19ᵇ האי אי׳ עד ארעא נחית (Ar. אסתוו׳) what is called ist’vira (ankle, in an anatomical sense) goes down to the ground (the entire length of the foot from the ankle).

<cite ref="Menachot 33a">Men. 33ᵃ</cite>, <he>דעבידא כי אי׳</he> a door turning horizontally like the foot from the ankle.—Pl. <he>אִיסְתְּוָורִין</he>, <he>רֵי …</he> <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Ecclesiastes 12:5">Targ. Koh. XII, 5</cite>; a. fr. Cmp. <cite ref="A03046"><he>אֲתוּרֵי</he></cite>.
